name: hermes_cli_voice_normalize_voice_record_key_for_prompt_toolkit
notes: voice.record_key -> prompt_toolkit binding normalizer (voice.c vs LIVE hermes_cli/voice.py). Harness is a rung-for-rung traced copy of the REAL C port ladder; the twin's value events come from the LIVE fn. KNOWN DIVERGENCE (inputs excluded): (1) LIVE strips whitespace around tokens (' ctrl + b ' -> c-b) while the C port does not, so whitespace-padded inputs diverge; (2) LIVE rejects reserved ctrl chars c/d/l (ctrl+c -> default c-b) and reserved alt chars on darwin, but the C port emits c-c/a-c — a real port gap worth a follow-up fix; excluded from the walk. Non-string inputs are unreachable via argv.
